registration_status: Freeze and publish these four supplementary files before the first supplementary smoke or main retrieval call.
reason: The original expanded stage follows target-source replacement/deletion, leaving targets at 15 pages. This separate matched experiment removes that source-change confound at 200k pages. The original nine-stage protocol and every observation remain unchanged and must still be reported.
evidence_class: Supplementary authored development control, designed after inspection of earlier main-run stages; not an untouched holdout.

invariants.source_sessions: Every stage uses the original frozen v014 generator. Later stages restore the preceding snapshot, then ingest unchanged core/existing sources plus additional foreign sessions. Unchanged sources are skipped by the public ingest path.
invariants.queries_and_gold: All original 108 cases, requirements, source coordinates, budgets, ordering and original 12 performance cases remain unchanged. Their canonical digest is bound before the first worker.
invariants.source_table_columns: Hash every target-owned row in projects, chapters, sessions, turns, sections and pages, with column lists saved in each fingerprint. Exclude only bookkeeping fields listed below and pages.rid from the source-table hash. Separately hash the full target page rid/id/project_id/session_pk mapping and compare target page count/min/max rowid placement.
invariants.preserved_source_metadata: sessions.created_at, raw_json, content_hash, settings_json, project names, chapter metadata, complete turns, page IDs, contents, exact source_refs and all other listed source-table columns are included.

measurement.backend: native for primary run; python permitted only as separately labeled repetition
measurement.unchanged_worker: benchmarks/v014_scale.py worker-build and worker-measure via the original scale.invoke. No global monkeypatch or modified original worker/scorer.
measurement.p95: Nearest rank. For 16 samples p95 equals the maximum. No confidence interval or significance claim.
measurement.timing_scope: Original public API timers unchanged. Snapshot copying/restoring, source fingerprints, journal writes and scoring remain outside query timers. First-request and after-foreign-write costs remain separately recorded.
measurement.work_scope: Original progress handlers on parent and cached local SQLite connections; separate calls, excludes internal FTS C work and initial projection construction.
measurement.cold_scope: Result-cache miss only; OS and SQLite page caches are not evicted.

storage.original_sqlite_bytes: Exact original bytes are authenticated before removing raw snapshots and after every restore. Original compressed snapshots and raw response journals are retained.

auditing: Separate supplementary auditor checks the exact registered stage/arm/round matrix, complete per-worker (case, mode, repetition, warm) identity multiset and all 108 quality cases per arm, protocol copies, original response pairing/hashes, per-worker runtime identity, unchanged target fingerprints, actual page counts, source slices, cache behavior and full registered gold. It reuses the original scoring rules without changing them. The execution guard requires a clean committed protocol HEAD before and throughout the run; offline auditing verifies the same bound file bytes and records that commit separately so that an artifact restore does not need a live Git checkout.
reporting: Report all stage/case/mode rows, failures, quality losses/gains, missing-evidence nonempty outputs, p50 and p95 with sample counts, first-preparation and foreign-write diagnostics, actual ranking route/fallback, VM counts and worker resources.
Report the complete original nine-stage run separately, including its 15-page post-deletion 200k stage; never replace or hide an unfavorable original stage.
No required-fields gate calls are included; retain its earlier diagnostics and limitations from the original experiment.
Public-source holdout regressions continue to block project-local ranking as a default. Supplementary scale improvements cannot override those regressions.

Evidence supports only these authored cases, source histories and environments. It does not prove constant-time behavior, universal retrieval correctness, RSS bounds, calibrated abstention or LLM coding-task success.
